answer_1.quote: Our experiments use these datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach to identify (un)answerability.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs are answers to questions, with evaluation focusing on whether the model correctly identifies if a question is answerable or unanswerable and produces appropriate responses (including 'unanswerable' when needed).

answer_2.quote: The metric associated with this task is the F1 score, with "unanswerable" considered the positive label.
